{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Final cleaned dataset
df_clean = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
df_clean['revenue_clean'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
qa_mask = df_clean['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
df_clean = df_clean[~qa_mask].copy()
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['customer_age'] != -1]

# Remove refunded orders for conversion rate (since they are not 'converted')
df_conv = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Check conversion rate by channel (only completed orders)
raw_conv_rate = df_conv.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('Raw conversion rate (completed only):')
print(raw_conv_rate)

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment in completed orders
df_conv_ct = pd.crosstab(df_conv['channel'], df_conv['customer_segment'])
print('\nCross-tabulation (completed orders):')
print(df_conv_ct)

# Standardised conversion rate using completed orders only
# Segment distribution in completed orders
segment_dist = df_conv['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Segment distribution per channel
channel_dist = df_conv.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True).unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute standardised conversion rate
standardised_conv = channel_dist.apply(lambda row: (row * segment_dist).sum() * 100, axis=1)
print('\nStandardised conversion rate (completed only):')
print(standardised_conv)

# Compute average revenue by channel (completed only)
avg_revenue = df_conv.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()
print('\nAverage revenue by channel (completed only):')
print(avg_revenue)"}
